paper.title: Towards the ground state of molecules via diffusion Monte Carlo on neural networks
paper.authors: Weiluo Ren, Weizhong Fu, Xiaojie Wu, Ji Chen

results.system_description: Cyclobutadiene, rectangular (D2h) minimum of Bhaskaran-Nair et al. (2008), all electrons, singlet (14 up, 14 down)
results.eligibility_evidence: FermiNet-VMC energy from a separate VMC inference run of the trained network (Supplementary Note 9).
results.notes: Geometry not printed. Supplementary Note 9 uses 'the default network structure in the open-source FermiNet repository for cyclobutadiene'; that repository's configs/organic.py gives the Bhaskaran-Nair et al. (2008) geometries recorded in this instance, which is an inference. The DMC columns are projector energies and the VMC* column is quoted from Spencer et al.; neither is recorded.
